sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Debrief with morning shift regarding the status of the CBD.
Commencing Alpha Route; arrived at corner of Victoria St East and Queen Street (HQ). Welfare check:
Welfare check Macca's Queen Street; standby to show presence to the public and afternoon commuters.
Response call from K Save Mart Convenience store: male individual who paid with fake cash, last seen heading up Queen Street.
Arrived and photographed the fake cash (photo on file); one team member pursued the individual's last-seen direction.
No trace of the individual; asked the public for assistance, no one had seen him.
Arrived at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square; full sweep, all clear.
Welfare check Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace and Aotea Centre, all clear.
Welfare check walkthrough of Bledisloe Building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Response call from Macca's Queen St: two vagrants in front of store, requesting assistance to move them to the side.
Arrived and asked the individuals to move to a mutual column; they complied.
Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone (11%).
Ops Phone at healthy battery; commencing Alpha Route.
Welfare check both Durham Street East and West alleyway, all clear.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane and stores within the vicinity, all clear.
Welfare check Imperial Lane, building sweep around the area, all clear.
Heading back to HQ to conduct mandatory building sweep.
Commencing routes again; building sweep complete.
Most stores closed for trading apart from a few convenience stores and fast food chains.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; full sweep, all clear.
Response call from Puffing Kiwi: two individuals inside the store bothering staff and making them uncomfortable; assistance requested.
Arrived; both males had already left. Staff reported being made uncomfortable — the males asked for their number and said they would wait outside for them after work.
Standing by in case the suspects circle back.
Staff asked to be escorted to their vehicle on Durham Street at 20:00 when they close; will return near closing for the escort.
Arrived at corner of Darby St and Queen St, all clear.
Welfare check Woolworths Victoria St West, all clear.
Arrived at Top of Victoria Street and Federal St, all clear.
Heading back to Puffing Kiwi to escort female staff member to her vehicle.
Standing by at Puffing Kiwi awaiting female staff to finish her shift.
Response message from Albert Mart Convenience store: two teenagers stole food and ran towards Customs St; pictures sent (photos on file). Will keep an eye out while on route.
Female staff worker at Puffing Kiwi finished; escorting her to her vehicle.
Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone (10%).
Ops Phone at healthy battery; commencing routes.
Arrived at corner of Shortland St and Queen St, all clear.
Welfare check Shortland Street Convenience store, all clear.
Arrived at Queens Arcade, all clear. Ending Echo Route, commencing Delta Route.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street: individual inside bothering customers; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived and asked the individual to exit the premises; he complied.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to Night shift.
